steps.en: TDS and EPS operators send payment evasion offences right away
steps.id: Operator TDS dan EPS mengirim offence payment evasion secara langsung
steps.why_en: No TDS or EPS connection exists; only a generic notice intake and a REPCCS one were found.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi TDS atau EPS; yang ditemukan hanya penerimaan notice umum dan satu untuk REPCCS.

steps.en: Offence details are checked for all required fields
steps.id: Detail offence dicek kelengkapan field wajibnya

steps.en: The offence rule code is checked against the rule list
steps.id: Kode aturan offence dicek terhadap daftar aturan

steps.en: The system checks if the same payment evasion was already recorded
steps.id: Sistem mengecek apakah payment evasion yang sama sudah tercatat

steps.en: The notice is set up according to the vehicle type
The correct offence notice type is decided automatically
steps.id: Jenis notice offence yang benar ditentukan otomatis
steps.why_en: The notice type comes from the sender or staff form and is not matched to the offence rule.
steps.why_id: Jenis notice datang dari pengirim atau form staf dan tidak dicocokkan dengan aturan offence.

steps.en: A notice can wait for the EEPS decision before it is created
steps.id: Notice bisa menunggu keputusan EEPS sebelum dibuat
steps.why_en: Every notice is created immediately; nothing holds it back for an EEPS decision.
steps.why_id: Setiap notice langsung dibuat; tidak ada yang menahannya untuk menunggu keputusan EEPS.

steps.en: The notice is saved and the sender gets the result
steps.id: Notice disimpan dan pengirim menerima hasilnya
